name: ai-phishing-project
description: A full-stack AI-powered cybersecurity platform that detects phishing attacks, analyzes human behavior risk, and educates users in real-time.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && cd ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ai"
